## About
Husband's Automotive is a small, family owned and operated repair shop in the heart of Scottsdale. Owners Dale and Laurie Husband are part of the daily operations, and Dale is always on hand to answer questions and help out in the shop when needed.
Our mechanics, Clayton, Joe and Travis, love cars and care about yours. Mandy grew up around her family's auto repair shop in the East Valley, and now she helps customers with all of their car needs and keeps them updated on their repairs.
Our mission has always been "Putting integrity back into the automotive repair business." Car repair is rarely fun or convenient, so we try to make the process as easy and enjoyable as we can.

## Services
- A/C service and repair: A/C service and repair to keep you comfortable on Scottsdale roads.
- Brake and suspension work: Brake service and repair, plus suspension work when the ride starts feeling off.
- Computer diagnostics: Computer diagnostics to track down what's going on with your car.
- Preventative maintenance: A convenient way to keep your car healthy and in top condition.
- Free used car inspections: Have a used car looked over before you buy it, at no charge. (Free)
- Free road trip inspections: Get your car checked before you head out on a road trip, at no charge. (Free)
- Fleet discount: Call Dale or Travis and ask about our fleet discount.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed on Saturday and Sunday and open Monday through Friday.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. We have a night drop available.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: We work on all makes and models, including Acura, BMW, Ford, Honda, Jeep, Lexus, Subaru, Toyota, Volvo and more.
